card.name: Punctuation and digits inside dose details
card.fires_on: Small punctuation marks, slashes, brackets and digits that sit inside dose numbers, section numbers or drug-name lists in drug labels. Examples are the slash in 320/25 mg, an opening parenthesis after a drug name, and the first digit of a number.

modes.label: Slash or bracket in doses
modes.description: A slash or opening parenthesis between or after drug names and strengths.

modes.label: Punctuation after drug names
modes.description: A comma, parenthesis or period right after a drug or regimen name in a trial or dosing list.

modes.label: Digit in numbers
modes.description: A leading digit in a section number or a count of patients.

card.plain: It fires on small marks and digits inside dose strengths, drug lists and section numbers in labels.
